PDF Emissive Clip Planes for Volume Rendering - Supplement.
Right Image: The clipped plane is rendered with emissive illumination. This removes the random lighting. The colon walls are the same. We present the emissive clip plane as a pragmatic solution for two illumination problems when cutting through a volume. First, noisy gradients create random lighting; second, back facing surfaces reveal dark areas. Both lighting and clipping are advantageous ...
